title: Code and hourly results for: Curtailed for security: Inertia rules when the largest loss is a renewable plant
description: Code and hourly results of a full-year, day-ahead unit commitment of the RTS-GMLC test system in which the loss of a whole wind plant is a credible event, used in the article Curtailed for security: Inertia rules when the largest loss is a renewable plant (The Electricity Journal, submitted). The code is licensed under MIT; the results and derived data are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-data).
